instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct word from the box below. Each word is used once. Word bank: Fund, Extremely, Fatigue, Inadequate, Balanced, Occurrence, Revolution, Evidence, Wound, Guilt, Construction, Approximately, Drought, Remedy, Dilemma, Congratulations.

items.questionText: After the marathon, the runners experienced extreme ________________ due to the long distance they had to cover.
The __________________ of the building took over a year to complete.

A_________________ diet is important for maintaining good health, involving the right proportions of different food groups.
The sudden ___________________ of the accident left everyone in shock.
___________________ to you on your promotion! You've worked really hard for it.

His ________________ led him to confess his mistake to the manager.
They had an ethical ___________________ about whether to use the new technology.
Drinking a/an _________________ amount of water can lead to dehydration and other health issues.
The government allocated a special __________________ to support small businesses.
He was ________________ busy with the new project and couldn't attend the meeting.

instruction: Choose the best answer for the following questions:

items.questionText: 1. What part of speech is the word "unsteady"?
2. Which word means "to treat or regard someone/something with contempt or disrespect"?
3. What does the word "faith" primarily refer to?
4. Which word means "a system of government by the whole population, typically through elected representatives"?
5. What is the antonym of "rough"?
6. Which word means "to protect against loss or damage"?
7. What does the word "furthermore" indicate?
8. Which word means "to admit or state that one has committed a crime or done something wrong"?
9. What does the word "revolution" primarily refer to?

options.text: b) A fundamental or drastic change

items.questionText: 10. What is the synonym of "decay"?
11. Which word means "a series of planned activities intended to achieve a particular social, commercial, or political aim"?
12. What is the opposite of "subjective"?
13. The manager decided to ___________ the employee for his excellent performance.
14. She studied very hard for the exam. ___________, she got the highest score in her class.
15. The heavy rain ___________ flooding in the downtown area.

instruction: The word in capitals at the end of each of the following lines can be used to form a word that fits in the blank space in the sentences. Spelling mistakes will be penalized.

items.questionText: This important discovery has _______________ our understanding of the universe. (REVOLUTION)
His wages were pitifully _______________ for the needs of his growing family. (ADEQUATE)
You may feel a little_______________ for a few days after the operation. (COMFORT)
I would have no _______________ in recommending Philip for the position. (HESITATE)
For a few moments he was pale and _______________ but his colour gradually returned. (STEADY)
He _______________ to sleeping through most of the movie. (CONFESSION)
Work out the exact design before you start _______________. (CONSTRUCT)
_______________ growth was fastest in Japan. (ECONOMY)
Burnett has campaigned against _______________ to animals for more than 20 years. (CRUEL)
As with all new ideas it was met with _______________. (RESISTANT)
When's the food coming? I'm _______________! (STARVATION)
We only see each other very _______________. (OCCASIONAL)
Indeed, the Prime Minister sent a message of _______________ to President Christiani when the peace agreement was reached. (CONGRATULATE)
Official _______________ has been granted for more building near the river. (PERMIT)
There have been major changes in the constitution, but the system remains _______________. (DEMOCRACY)

instruction: Please fill in the gaps in the following text about ‘social change’ with the appropriate vocabulary from the box below. There are more words than you need. Word bank: Resistance, Starve, Withdraw, Decay, Grateful, Discomfort, Gear, Faith, Campaign, Ultimate, Hesitation, Evolution.

items.questionText: In the early stages of any major social change, there is often a great deal of {1} from those who are comfortable with the status quo. People may feel a sense of hesitation about the new direction, fearing the {2} that comes with leaving behind the familiar. This feeling is not without reason; change can be unsettling and bring about a sense of uneasiness. However, for a society to progress, it must embrace the {3} of new ideas and practices. Those who {4} from participating in this change may find themselves feeling left behind as the world moves forward.  Successful change requires a well-organized and thoughtful {5}, where everyone is working together towards the {6} goal. Without this collective effort, the movement may fall apart. Thus, it's important to put the right scaffolding in place to support and sustain the change.
